description: This file declares classes and methods for Android-specific SPNEGO/Kerberos HTTP authentication support within Chromium, including a thread-safe callback wrapper and the main authentication mechanism class.

classes.name: JavaNegotiateResultWrapper
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper for SetResult callback, used for communication between Java and native code.

classes.name: HttpAuthNegotiateAndroid
classes.description: Android-specific implementation of HTTP Negotiate (SPNEGO/Kerberos) authentication mechanism.

methods.name: JavaNegotiateResultWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing callback task runner and callback function.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Sets the result and token, called from Java.

methods.name: HttpAuthNegotiateAndroid
methods.description: Constructor for creating an Android negotiate auth session.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Checks if explicit credentials are allowed.

methods.name: GenerateAuthTokenAndroid
methods.description: Android-specific method to generate auth token.

methods.name: GetAuthAndroidNegotiateAccountType
methods.description: Returns the account type used for negotiation.

methods.name: SetResultInternal
methods.description: Internal method to set result and token.
